name: FORNO® 3 Burner Stainless Steel Commercial Natural Gas Deep Fryer
shortDescription: The Forno Commercial Natural Gas Deep Fryer is built for high-volume frying with a durable stainless steel construction that ensures long-lasting performance and low maintenance. Three 30,000 BTU burners deliver consistent heat, while precision thermostatic controls allow adjustable temperatures from 200°F to 400°F for reliable cooking results. Dual wire mesh baskets with cool-touch handles and a full port drain valve improve efficiency and safety during operation.

features.text: Designed with a compact vertical build, adjustable legs, and a built-in backsplash, this fryer simplifies cleaning and maximizes kitchen space. The self-sufficient snap-action thermostat requires no electrical connection, making installation straightforward. For added safety, advanced overheating protection keeps operations secure. Ideal for any commercial kitchen, this fryer combines power, durability, and ease of use to increase productivity and output.
Robust Stainless Steel Build
Crafted to withstand the rigors of a bustling kitchen, the durable stainless steel exterior and fry tank ensure longevity and ease of maintenance.
Powerful Three Stainless Steel Burners
Equipped with four 30,000 BTU burners, this fryer delivers exceptional power to handle high-volume orders seamlessly.
Precision Thermostatic Controls
Easily adjust frying temperatures between 200-400°F for optimal cooking flexibility, ensuring perfect results for a variety of dishes.
Effortless Oil Drainage
The full port drain valve simplifies the process of draining used oil, enhancing kitchen efficiency and safety.
Dual Wire Mesh Fry Baskets
Maximize your cooking efficiency with two separate baskets, featuring heat-resistant handles for safe and comfortable operation.
Convenient Basket Hangers
Keep your workspace tidy and enhance oil drainage by hanging baskets on the side of the fryer, freeing you to focus on other tasks.
Self-Sufficient Snap-Action Thermostat
This fryer operates without the need for an electric connection, thanks to its reliable millivolt thermostat control behind the door.
Advanced Safety Features
With built-in overheating protection that activates at 450°F, this fryer prioritizes the safety of your kitchen staff and protects your equipment.
Space-Efficient Vertical Design
Ideal for small kitchens and food trucks, this fryer's compact dimensions (15.5” W x 31.3” L x 45.3” H) optimize workspace flow.
Adjustable Legs for Easy Cleaning
Maintain cleanliness with ease; the 6" legs can extend up to 1.5" higher, simplifying the process of cleaning under the fryer.
Easy-to-Clean Surfaces
The fryer features a smooth, non-stick stainless steel surface that makes cleaning quick and simple, minimizing downtime and maintaining hygiene standards effortlessly.
Integrated Backsplash for Wall Protection
Includes a built-in backsplash, effectively shielding your kitchen walls from grease and stains, promoting a cleaner, maintenance-free environment.
